name: Age-related nuclear cataract
summary: Nuclear sclerosis: the lens nucleus yellows then browns, scatters more light and absorbs blue; the red reflex dims.

revealed_by.optic_section_lens: Nucleus yellow (grades 1-2) to brown (3-4) with rising backscatter; in dense nuclei the deep part of the section fades.
revealed_by.diffuse: Pupil looks yellow to amber-brown instead of black.
revealed_by.retroillumination: Red reflex dims with grade; dense nuclei give a dull reflex with a darker centre.

teaching_points: Grade nuclear colour and opalescence in the optic section, not in diffuse light.
Colour darkens and dulls with grade; dense nuclei are brown, not bright orange.
A dense nucleus needs more phaco energy and puts the endothelium at risk; check endothelial count.

provenance.source: LOCS III: Chylack et al., Arch Ophthalmol 111:831 (1993); values render-calibrated
